Agent.note: Fixed choice. Langfuse PR uses 智能体; Dify keeps "Agent" in English. 智能体 is the common mainland term.

Session.note: Dify and Langfuse PR both use 会话.

Chat.note: Dify uses 对话 for the chat surface; Langfuse PR uses 聊天. 对话 reads as a product feature, 聊天 as casual talk.

Message.note: Langfuse PR and Dify use 消息.

Trace.note: Langfuse PR uses 追踪 most, 链路 for the Traces page; Dify keeps "Trace" or uses 追踪. Pick 追踪 for one term everywhere.

Span.note: Dify keeps "Span"; Langfuse PR mixes 跨度 and Span. OpenTelemetry users in China say Span.

Observability.note: Langfuse PR uses 可观测性.

Evaluation.note: Langfuse PR uses 评估; Dify uses 评测. 评估 matches 评估器 for evaluator.

Evaluator.note: Langfuse PR uses 评估器. Dify has no evaluator.

Testset.note: Neither source has it (Langfuse uses 数据集 for dataset). 测试集 is the standard ML term.

Testcase.note: Neither source has it. 测试用例 is the standard software term.

Playground.note: Langfuse PR uses 调试台. Dify has no playground page (it uses 调试与预览).

Prompt.note: Dify and Langfuse PR both use 提示词.

Instructions.note: Dify uses 指令 for agent instructions.

Memory.note: Dify uses 记忆 for chat memory.

Variant.note: Neither source has it. 变体 is the usual term for an A/B variant.

Version.note: Dify and Langfuse PR both use 版本.

Commit.note: Langfuse PR and Dify use 提交 (提交说明 for commit message).

Deploy.note: Dify and Langfuse PR both use 部署. Use 部署 for Deployment too.

Environment.note: Dify and Langfuse PR both use 环境.

Annotation.note: Dify and Langfuse PR both use 标注 (标注队列 for annotation queue).

Score.note: Langfuse PR uses 评分; Dify uses 分数 or 得分.

Feedback.note: Dify and Langfuse PR both use 反馈.

Cost.note: Langfuse PR uses 费用 most, 成本 sometimes. Pick 费用.

Token.note: Langfuse PR mixes Token and 令牌; Dify keeps Token. Keep "Token" for LLM tokens; 令牌 reads as an access token.

Skill.note: Langfuse PR uses 技能 (智能体技能); Dify keeps "Skill". 技能 fits the localized 智能体.

Tool.note: Dify and Langfuse PR both use 工具.

Tool call.note: Dify and Langfuse PR both use 工具调用.

Approve.note: Langfuse PR uses 批准 for tool-call approval; Dify uses 审批 for workflow sign-off. Agenta approval is the tool-call case.

Deny.note: Pairs with 批准. Neither source has the exact word.

Trigger.note: Dify and Langfuse PR use 触发器.

Schedule.note: Dify uses 定时任务 and 定时触发.

Channel.note: Dify uses 渠道 for messaging channels; Langfuse PR mixes 频道 and 渠道. 频道 suits a Slack channel, 渠道 a connected channel type.

Integration.note: Dify and Langfuse PR both use 集成.

Connection.note: Dify and Langfuse PR both use 连接.

Run.note: Dify and Langfuse PR both use 运行.

Runner.note: Neither source has it. 运行器 follows 运行.

Sandbox.note: Dify mixes Sandbox, 沙箱 and 沙盒; Langfuse PR uses 沙盒. Pick 沙箱, the common cloud term.

Harness.note: Neither source has it. Keep English until a native speaker picks a term (for example 运行框架).

Mount.note: Neither source has it. 挂载 is the standard file-system term.

Model.note: Dify and Langfuse PR both use 模型.

Provider.note: Langfuse PR and most Dify strings use 提供商; Dify also has 供应商.

Endpoint.note: Dify and Langfuse PR use 端点.

Gateway.note: Neither source has it. 网关 is the standard term.

Project.note: Fixed choice. Dify and Langfuse PR both use 项目.

Workspace.note: Fixed choice. Dify mixes 工作区 and 工作空间.

Organization.note: Dify and Langfuse PR both use 组织.

Member.note: Fixed choice. Dify and Langfuse PR both use 成员.

Owner.note: Dify and Langfuse PR use 所有者.

Admin.note: Dify and Langfuse PR both use 管理员.

Editor.note: Neither source has the role. 编辑者 pairs with 查看者.

API key.note: Fixed choice. Dify and Langfuse PR both use API 密钥.

Secret.note: Fixed choice. Dify and Langfuse PR use 密钥 for secret keys. Same word as in API 密钥.

Webhook.note: Fixed choice. Dify and Langfuse PR keep Webhook.

Credits.note: Dify uses 额度 (消息额度). Langfuse PR has 额度 for provider credits.

Billing.note: Dify uses 账单; Langfuse PR mixes 计费 and 账单. Pick 账单.

Plan.note: Dify and Langfuse PR both use 套餐 for a pricing plan.

Subscription.note: Dify and Langfuse PR both use 订阅.

Usage.note: Dify and Langfuse PR both use 用量.

Settings.note: Dify and Langfuse PR both use 设置.

Home.note: Langfuse PR uses 首页; Dify mixes 首页 and 主页. Pick 首页.

Template.note: Dify and Langfuse PR both use 模板.

Configuration.note: Dify and Langfuse PR both use 配置.

Parameter.note: Dify and Langfuse PR both use 参数.

Variable.note: Dify and Langfuse PR both use 变量.

Input.note: Dify and Langfuse PR both use 输入.

Output.note: Dify and Langfuse PR both use 输出.

Query.note: Dify and Langfuse PR both use 查询.

Filter.note: Dify and Langfuse PR both use 筛选 (筛选条件 for the filter itself).

Tag.note: Dify and Langfuse PR both use 标签.

Archive.note: Dify and Langfuse PR both use 归档.

Logs.note: Dify and Langfuse PR both use 日志.
